title: 1460. Make Two Arrays Equal by Reversing Subarrays

examples.explanation: You can follow the next steps to convert arr to target: 1- Reverse subarray [2,4,1], arr becomes [1,4,2,3] 2- Reverse subarray [4,2], arr becomes [1,2,4,3] 3- Reverse subarray [4,3], arr becomes [1,2,3,4] There are multiple ways to convert arr to target, this is not the only way to do so.
arr is equal to target without any reverses.
arr does not have value 9 and it can never be converted to target.
